entities.name: Rustam Djangabaev
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Rustam Djangabaev is an Uzbekistani heavyweight weightlifter. He won a gold medal at the 2017 Asian Championships and a bronze at the 2018 Asian Games. He placed sixth at the 2016 Olympics.
